A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''child''' adventured with a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An obnoxious brat, he once wrestled a [[Unidentified pirate (Dantooine)|pirate]] out of a hatch, forcing the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to jump from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantoooine]] using nothing but an [[ablative heatshield]] and a [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]] to rescue him. The kid and bounty hunter eventually parted ways.<ref name="RPG" />
